claude-opus-5-5.note: All the key elements are present and roughly placed, but the recreation turns the three sparse towers into a dense skyline, makes the searchlights purple instead of cyan, adds extra cacti, and uses a more saturated, illustrative style than the original's smoother, more photoreal look.

openai-gpt-6-sol.note: Nearly all key elements are present, but the recreation shifts their positions and makes the city, neon lighting, and foreground much brighter and more stylized.
